name: hyperframes-whisper
description: Personal HyperFrames video creation, script planning, local video library and Whisper transcription workflows.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit videos with bundled HyperFrames skills, plan scripts, find local videos, and transcribe audio or video with local Whisper. Requires a desktop coding runtime, Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg. Runtime and speech models download on first use. No HeyGen account library connection is included. Personal customization, not an official HeyGen or OpenAI product.
defaultPrompt: Create a video from my script.
Transcribe my video and export subtitles.
Find and summarize videos in my project folder.
